41def4d5-8829-593c-8733-6299640e374e.name: +75% to the effects of Random Affixes on this Prism
41def4d5-8829-593c-8733-6299640e374e.description: +75% to the effects of Random Affixes on this Prism

ff5e1380-f855-55b5-8151-cc3bd488afa8.name: One For All
ff5e1380-f855-55b5-8151-cc3bd488afa8.description: Gains Cold and Lightning Resistance equal to 50% of Fire Resistance

3edf4359-0ba4-5496-9968-29f12db54fda.name: Unwavering Fortress
3edf4359-0ba4-5496-9968-29f12db54fda.description:
Gains Defense equal to 1.5% of Armor and absorbs 100% of Non-True Damage taken every 10s. Defense is refreshed when gained again
Max Life is fixed at 100
Your Evasion and Max Energy Shield are fixed at 0

d621b548-19b2-5611-9de7-cc0af80c2d31.name: Unstoppable Force
d621b548-19b2-5611-9de7-cc0af80c2d31.description: When a Combo Finisher is in Multistrike, it is guaranteed to deal damage equal to the Max Multistrike Count

bf6ce15a-b064-5314-ba66-7e3152c05137.name: Hare's Agility
bf6ce15a-b064-5314-ba66-7e3152c05137.description:
When exiting Stand Still, gains 1 stack of buff that lasts for 2s, up to 5 time(s)
+14% additional damage dealt to enemies in proximity for each stack of this buff. +8% Attack Speed

113dd8fa-b86b-5255-89b6-c7548f690f23.name: Sweeping Fury
113dd8fa-b86b-5255-89b6-c7548f690f23.description:
On hit, Main Ranged Horizontal Projectile Skills have a 100% chance to cast an additional Main Skill, whose projectiles fire in a ring and deal -60% additional damage. Interval: 0.03s. Does not affect Sentry Skills, Vertical Skills, and Channeled Skills.
Projectile Quantity upper limit: 5
+2 Horizontal Projectile Penetration(s)

d6123d0b-7ed5-58f2-8f51-8340c4911719.name: Keen Intellect
d6123d0b-7ed5-58f2-8f51-8340c4911719.description:
Gains different buffs based on the number of different Spell Skills equipped: For every Empower Skill equipped, +13% additional Spell Damage (multiplies)
For every Curse Skill equipped, +6% Elemental and Erosion Resistance Penetration and +6% Armor DMG Mitigation Penetration
For every Defensive Skill equipped, +13% additional Max Mana (multiplies)
For every Mobility Skill equipped, +13% additional Cast Speed (multiplies)

4ef6b311-4469-5932-b7e4-b07aee921cc3.name: Towering Presence
4ef6b311-4469-5932-b7e4-b07aee921cc3.description:
Adds 100% of Main-Hand Weapon's Damage to Spells
Adds 75% of Main-Hand Weapon's Critical Strike Rating to the Base Critical Strike Rating of Spell Skills
-99% additional Ailment Damage

7e0f0cf8-a6d5-51cd-b0b2-cbc7dde0b39a.name: Spell Ripple
7e0f0cf8-a6d5-51cd-b0b2-cbc7dde0b39a.description: Spell Skills on hit have a 50% chance to spawn a Pulse, dealing True Damage equal to 150% of Hit Damage. Interval: 0.03s

434e1993-5f6d-5410-bac2-e3d68ba7517f.name: Juggernaut
434e1993-5f6d-5410-bac2-e3d68ba7517f.description: Reduces 10% Armor and 2% Elemental and Erosion Resistance for enemies on Critical Strike for 8s. Stacks up to 10 time(s)

37bdf2ff-0e4b-5a33-99fe-3fb312f5c2f1.name: Adaptive Defense
37bdf2ff-0e4b-5a33-99fe-3fb312f5c2f1.description:
If you haven't been hit recently, +40% Injury Buffer. This effect lasts for 4s longer when you are hit
If you have been hit recently, gains 1 stack of Deflection every 0.5s

78d928a9-16a2-54cb-b512-5b5cd5896b2d.name: Unmatched Valor
78d928a9-16a2-54cb-b512-5b5cd5896b2d.description: Has 130 point(s) of fixed Fervor Rating

18f84bfc-db40-5d7a-8398-d50383629215.name: Self-Delusion
18f84bfc-db40-5d7a-8398-d50383629215.description:
+12% additional Erosion Damage to an enemy for each type of Crowd Control Effect they are under
Crowd Control Effects inflicted are reflected back onto you

b8ed0ed9-e842-5dd2-ab92-815ae5d01708.name: Escalating Affliction
b8ed0ed9-e842-5dd2-ab92-815ae5d01708.description:
Changes the effect of each point of Affliction to: +0.1% - +3% additional Damage Over Time taken. Refreshes every 1s and is affected by Lucky Damage bonuses
90% of the bonuses and additional bonuses for Max Damage is also applied to Damage Over Time

3285e0ed-e54d-570d-bd2d-e286d16d1fc1.name: Commander's Gambit
3285e0ed-e54d-570d-bd2d-e286d16d1fc1.description:
-100% additional Tenacity Blessing, Agility Blessing, and Focus Blessing Effect
When gaining any Blessing, Minions within 10m also gain it
Minions' max Blessing stacks are twice your own

7b93631d-485a-5a8a-aead-ae0267f1f84a.name: Circle of Life
7b93631d-485a-5a8a-aead-ae0267f1f84a.description:
Gains Growth equal to 80% of the nearest Spirit Magus every 1s, and Growth gains Return Speed equal to Command
For every 10 Growth, +1% additional damage for Spirit Magi, +0.1% additional Physique and +0.5% Skill Area for yourself

2c23cb96-c2da-5483-a541-945a843b2658.name: Miraculous Touch
2c23cb96-c2da-5483-a541-945a843b2658.description:
Triggers Miraculous Gain when casting an Elixir Skill
Elixir Skills gain 1 Charging Progress every second

ec5a05dc-92b1-51ea-a9c3-a30e96a8f6a3.name: Dark Advance
ec5a05dc-92b1-51ea-a9c3-a30e96a8f6a3.description:
Moves in the target direction when casting Dark Gate
+3 Max Charges for Dark Gate
+50% additional Cooldown Recovery Speed for Dark Gate
+30% additional Minion Damage if a Dark Gate has been cast recently

0e14236d-429c-54ed-9ed0-d35b441d7221.name: Crushing Blast
0e14236d-429c-54ed-9ed0-d35b441d7221.description:
Enemies have a 25% chance to explode when defeated by Attacks or Spells, dealing True Damage equal to 250% of their Max Life to enemies within a 5m radius
+30% additional damage dealt to Elites

eeeb8034-b939-5bab-a429-400f7a831dc4.name: Storm's Command
eeeb8034-b939-5bab-a429-400f7a831dc4.description:
For each different Warcry cast, +35% additional Attack Damage for 8s
-100% additional Empower Skill and Defensive Skill Effect

ed742654-e1db-54d0-8245-4b6c1f512941.name: Fire's Allure
ed742654-e1db-54d0-8245-4b6c1f512941.description:
Inflicts Scorch instead of Ignite
Nearby enemies within 10m -10% Fire Resistance for each stack of Scorch on them

52a839c0-1177-5a1b-9b26-031bba542ebd.name: Fiery Fantasy
52a839c0-1177-5a1b-9b26-031bba542ebd.description:
+3% additional Ignite Damage, up to +150%, for every +1% Ignite Chance above 100%
+3% additional Wilt Damage, up to +150%, for every +1% Wilt Chance above 100%
+3% additional Trauma Damage, up to +150%, for every +1% Trauma Chance above 100%
